content: Claude Code marketplace: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with name, owner{name}, plugins[{name, source}], optional description/version/category/keywords; sources: relative path, github, git url, npm, archive; plugin needs .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name, description, version, author); bump version for updates or omit to track SHA; 'claude plugin validate .'; users add with /plugin marketplace add owner/repo and /plugin install name@marketplace. Official directory (anthropics/claude-plugins-official) and community directory (anthropics/claude-plugins-community) accept submissions at clau.de/plugin-directory-submission; review checks manifest spec, files present, no access outside plugin dir, clear skill instructions, README with install/usage; community gets automated security scan. Codex: skills at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (name + description frontmatter, optional scripts/ references/ assets/ agents/openai.yaml), also ~/.agents/skills and /etc/codex/skills; package as plugin with .codex-plugin/plugin.json + skills/; 'codex plugin marketplace add owner/repo' and 'codex plugin add name@marketplace'; shared ChatGPT/Codex plugin directory. README adoption: visitors decide in <30 s; first screen must have one-line what, install command, demo; CONTRIBUTING.md, license, quickstart on one sample in ten minutes.
